evals.prompt: Add a cache for these API responses.
evals.expected_output: Uses a stdlib/built-in caching primitive (e.g. functools.lru_cache) on the existing fetch function. No new dependency, no custom cache class/wrapper, minimal diff.
expectations: Solution does not add a new third-party caching dependency (e.g. cachetools, redis, requests-cache) to requirements/imports
Solution does not introduce a custom cache class or wrapper abstraction
Solution uses a standard-library caching primitive appropriate to the language (e.g. functools.lru_cache) applied directly to the existing function
Response explanation is short (a few lines), not a design write-up
